question: For an offer whose only free route is a time-limited trial with no perpetual free lane, the binding constraint is the trial deletion clock (retention-clamped) rather than a usage quota. Is that the right binding kind for trial-only providers, or should the vocabulary gain a dedicated cost/trial-expiry term?
why: The ArangoDB Oasis draft names binding retention-clamped with a 14-day deletion and no paid floor free fallback; the closed vocabulary has no term for a trial expiry or a cost-based minimum, so the nearest valid term was used and the true constraint is named in binding_note and notes.
